title: Ponte Preta vs Juventude: Decisive clash in Serie B
seoTitle: Ponte Preta vs Juventude: Decisive Serie B Clash
subtitle: Round 32 match could change the lead and avoid the division's worst campaign
excerpt: On Tuesday, at 9:35 PM, Ponte Preta and Juventude face each other in Indaiatuba for the 32nd round of Serie B.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Ponte Preta and Juventude take the field this Tuesday, at 9:35 PM (Brasília time), at the Ítalo Mário Limongi Stadium in Indaiatuba (SP), for the 32nd round of Serie B. The match stands out because Juventude can take the lead and Ponte Preta is trying to escape the worst campaign in the division's history.

What is at stake for Ponte Preta

Relegated with seven rounds to spare, Macaca has only 13 points, the result of three wins, four draws, and 24 losses. The club is still trying to avoid the negative record of finishing the competition with the worst campaign in Serie B history, currently held by Duque de Caxias, which earned 17 points in 2011.

What is at stake for Juventude

Juventude arrives at the match after beating Operário-PR at Alfredo Jaconi, securing their second consecutive victory and keeping their defense undefeated in 21 Serie B matches. With one point less than leaders Vila Nova, the team can reclaim the top spot if they win and the team from Goiás fails to score in the upcoming round.

Broadcast and real-time coverage

The match will be broadcast live by Disney+, GOAT, and Rede TV. Ge will track the plays in real time.

Predicted lineups

Ponte Preta: Vinicius Ferrari; Sérgio Palacios, Gabriel Caran, and Gustavo Almeida (Diego Leão); Júlio, Rodrigo Souza (Gustavo Telles), Manu, Dênis Borges, and Diego Porfírio; Brandão and Danilo Peu (Miguel). Out: Elvis, Kevyson, and Cafu (injured); Juan and David da Hora (suspended). Yellow-carded: Júlio, Diego Porfírio, and Sérgio Palacios.

Juventude: Jandrei; Rodrigo Sam, Messias, and Gabriel Pinheiro; Aderlan, Mandaca, Gabriel Pires, Raí Silva, and Diogo Barbosa; Fábio Lima and Alisson Safira. Out: Marcos Paulo (suspended) and Allanzinho (left knee injury). Yellow-carded: Wadson, Rodrigo Sam, Gabriel Pinheiro, Luan Martins, Fábio Lima, Mandaca, and Aderlan.

Refereeing

Head referee: Arthur Gomes Rabelo (ES). Assistants: Pedro Amorim de Freitas (ES) and Patrícia Nascimento (BA). Fourth official: Murilo Tarrega (SP). VAR: Daniel Victor Costa (MG).

With information from ge, Estadão.
